$comment: THE single place the publish/update target is written down.
Nothing in code, CI, or the launcher may hardcode a repository owner or
name. Everything resolves this file at runtime (see tools/release_source.py
and tools/bfme-launcher-mcp/src/release-source.mjs), and every field can be
overridden by an environment variable so a build or a player can retarget
The value below is a DEFAULT, not a constant. It has already changed
twice. If 'repository' is ever null the resolvers raise a clear error
instead of guessing a URL, so a publish or update path fails loudly
rather than silently pointing at the wrong host.
$retiredComment: Targets that must never be used again, in machine-readable form.
This list is not documentation. The launcher refuses to build or run against any
repository named here, so a stale config or a bad merge fails loudly instead of
pointing the updater at a dead or reassigned repository. A retired GitHub name can
be claimed by someone else, which makes silently updating from one a supply-chain
problem, not just a broken link.
This is also the ONE file allowed to name a release target at all (see the
allow-list in tools/export-scan.ps1), which is why the names live here and are
read from here rather than repeated in code or tests.

notes.visibility: PRIVATE repo. Retail-derived bytes still must never be uploaded to a third-party host regardless of visibility.
notes.retired: Ancalgonn/open-bfme-engine (retired) and Open-BFME/openbmfe-godot (typo, dead) must never be reintroduced as fallbacks.
notes.existingHistory: Target main already has an auto-init commit (README only). A publish must reconcile with it, not assume an empty repo.
